instruction: Use Bonsai's native IFC authoring workflow to create a new metric IFC4 model for a simple single-room building shell. Start from a blank project; no init_file inputs or reference images are provided. Save the completed model as result.ifc in the output folder. The model should contain one project, one site, one building, one building storey, one space, four walls, one slab, one door, one window, two opening elements, two void relationships, and two fill relationships. Do not use building element proxies, furniture, roofs, columns, beams, stairs, or flow terminals. Give every IfcRoot object a unique GlobalId. Name the space Room 101 and model it with world-coordinate plan spans of 5.20 m in X and 4.40 m in Y, with about 0.10 m tolerance. Each wall should be 3.00 m high, with about 0.10 m tolerance. Add an Entry Door with OverallWidth 0.90 m hosted in an opening in West Wall, and add a North Window with OverallWidth 1.40 m hosted in a separate opening in North Wall. Other details may vary as long as these requirements are met.
